metadata.selection_goal: Identify a diverse set of Ubuntu 24.04 software that directly uses libc6 at runtime and, where relevant, also uses glibc development packages at build time.
selection_method: Used apt-cache policy and apt-cache show on an Ubuntu 24.04 host configured for noble, noble-updates, and noble-security to record candidate binary packages and direct Depends or Pre-Depends edges to libc6.
Used apt-cache showsrc to record source-package Build-Depends on libc6-dev or multiarch variants such as libc6-dev-i386 for compile-time use.
For brevity, each evidence field keeps only the libc6-bearing fragment rather than the full dependency line.

dependents.name: bash
dependents.runtime_functionality_depending_on_libc6: Interactive shell sessions and execution of Bash scripts.

dependents.name: coreutils
dependents.runtime_functionality_depending_on_libc6: Running base userland commands such as ls, cp, mv, rm, cat, sort, and friends.

dependents.name: systemd
dependents.runtime_functionality_depending_on_libc6: PID 1 init, unit activation, service supervision, and related system-management helpers.

dependents.name: python3.12-minimal
dependents.runtime_functionality_depending_on_libc6: Starting the Python 3.12 interpreter and running Python scripts.

dependents.name: git
dependents.runtime_functionality_depending_on_libc6: Repository operations such as clone, fetch, commit, diff, merge, and checkout.

dependents.name: openssh-client
dependents.runtime_functionality_depending_on_libc6: SSH login sessions, remote command execution, and SCP or SFTP transfers.

dependents.name: network-manager
dependents.runtime_functionality_depending_on_libc6: Managing network interfaces, connection profiles, DHCP, and related connectivity orchestration.

dependents.name: nginx
dependents.runtime_functionality_depending_on_libc6: HTTP serving, reverse proxying, and TLS termination.

dependents.name: postgresql-16
dependents.runtime_functionality_depending_on_libc6: Accepting client connections, executing SQL queries, and managing database storage.

dependents.name: ffmpeg
dependents.runtime_functionality_depending_on_libc6: Decoding, encoding, transcoding, remuxing, and streaming media from the CLI.

dependents.name: qemu-system-x86

dependents.name: podman
dependents.runtime_functionality_depending_on_libc6: Creating, running, and managing OCI containers and pods.

dependents.name: gnome-shell
dependents.runtime_functionality_depending_on_libc6: The GNOME desktop shell UI, overview, and compositor-side desktop interaction.

dependents.name: valgrind

dependents.runtime_functionality_depending_on_libc6: Managing virtual machines, storage, and virtual networks through the libvirt daemon and APIs.
